scripts.build:android-debug: node scripts/write-android-debug-env.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode android-debug
scripts.build:android-staging: node scripts/write-android-staging-env.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode android-staging
scripts.build:android-release: node scripts/write-android-release-env.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode android-release
scripts.cap:sync:android-release: npm run build:android-release && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:bundle-release: npm run cap:sync:android-release && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android-debug: npm run build:android-debug && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:android-staging: npm run build:android-staging && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:assemble-staging-debug: npm run cap:sync:android-staging && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
